rounds.ai_message: Good morning, Mr. Chen. I'm David Reynolds, lead auditor from SGS. We're doing a BSCI full audit today, plus a separate SA8000 review. Can we start by seeing the production schedule and the attendance log?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 陈先生早上好。我是 SGS 的首席审核员 David Reynolds。我们今天做一次 BSCI 全审,外加一次 SA8000 独立审核。先从生产计划和考勤记录开始,可以吗?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 准备好文件 + 安排陪同人员 + 给时间表
key_phrases: Welcome, Mr. Reynolds. Let me introduce our team.
Here's the production schedule and the attendance log
We've allocated 4 hours for the document review
rounds.common_mistakes: BSCI(欧洲)+ SA8000(美国社会责任标准)是两个体系,不要混,准备两套文件。
rounds.tips_zh: BSCI 审核清单:工资工时 / 健康安全 / 禁止强迫劳动 / 禁止歧视 / 环保,11 个 performance area。
rounds.user_response_example: Welcome, Mr. Reynolds. Let me introduce our HR manager Ms. Wang and our compliance officer Mr. Liu. Here's the production schedule and the attendance log for the past 12 months. We've allocated 4 hours for the document review — please let's know if you need more time.

rounds.ai_message: Let me start with the worker interview. We'd like to talk to 8 workers in private, with no management present. Can you arrange a meeting room and ensure no supervisor is within earshot?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 先做员工访谈。我想在无管理层在场的情况下,跟 8 名员工分别谈。能不能安排一个会议室,确保没有主管在听?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 配合 + 强调公司欢迎第三方访谈 + 提供便利
key_phrases: The meeting room on the 3rd floor is reserved
We'll have a sign on the door — 'private interview in progress'
rounds.common_mistakes: 员工访谈(employee interview)是 BSCI/SA8000 核心环节,管理层回避是硬要求。不要试图陪同或翻译。
rounds.tips_zh: 挑选访谈员工:覆盖不同工种(车缝/裁剪/包装)、不同时段(白班/夜班)、不同工龄。
rounds.user_response_example: Absolutely — we welcome private interviews, that's our standard practice. The meeting room on the 3rd floor is reserved for the next 3 hours, and a sign on the door will read 'private interview in progress'. Our HR manager can help with the worker selection list, but she won't be in the room.

rounds.ai_message: One thing I noticed on the document review — the working hours log shows an average of 62 hours per week, including overtime. That's above the BSCI 60-hour threshold. Explain.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 我看到一个问题 — 考勤记录显示平均周工时 62 小时,含加班。超过 BSCI 60 小时上限。解释一下。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 不要否认,给原因 + 改善承诺
key_phrases: It's driven by Q4 peak season
We're committing to a 56-hour weekly cap from next month
rounds.common_mistakes: 62 小时超 BSCI 标准(60h),承认后给改善计划,不要找理由(订单压力不算理由)。
rounds.tips_zh: 国际客户常见工时上限:BSCI 60h,SA8000 48h + 加班 12h。工厂目标:周 56h 以下 + 月加班 36h 以下。
rounds.user_response_example: We acknowledge the gap — 62 hours isn't acceptable by BSCI standards. The driver is Q4 peak season with a major US retailer's program. From January 1st, we're committing to a 56-hour weekly cap, with monthly management review. Our compliance officer Mr. Liu will own the implementation.

rounds.ai_message: OK. Now the chemical management — I see you have an MSDS file, but the chemicals storage room doesn't have a ventilation system. That's a 'non-conformity' under BSCI Health & Safety. How soon can you fix it?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 行。再说化学品管理 — 我看到你有 MSDS 文件,但化学品仓库没有通风系统。这在 BSCI 健康安全下是 '不符合项'。多久能改?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 给具体改进时间表 + 区分 critical vs general non-conformity
key_phrases: We'll install mechanical ventilation within 30 days
We'll isolate the chemical storage from production in the meantime
This is a general non-conformity, not critical
rounds.common_mistakes: BSCI 评级:Critical(零容忍)/ Major(可补救)/ General(改进项)。通风缺失是 General,可补救。
rounds.tips_zh: 通风系统是低成本改进(几千到几万人民币),不要拖,30 天内能搞定。
rounds.user_response_example: We'll install mechanical ventilation within 30 days, with a quotation already requested from a local HVAC vendor. In the meantime, we'll isolate the chemical storage room, restrict access, and post warning signs. This is a general non-conformity, not critical, and we'll close it before the follow-up audit.

rounds.ai_message: Last item — the worker dormitory. I want to inspect it now. Is that OK?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 最后 — 员工宿舍。我现在想去看看,可以吗?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 开门让查,不要挡,挡 = 怀疑
key_phrases: The dormitory is 5 minutes' walk from the main building
rounds.common_mistakes: BSCI 审核员要看宿舍,任何阻拦都 = 立刻 red flag。
rounds.tips_zh: 宿舍检查清单:人均面积(>3 ㎡)、消防通道、隐私(异性不进)、饮用水、卫生设施。
rounds.user_response_example: Of course, please follow me. The dormitory is 5 minutes' walk from the main building, with separate buildings for male and female workers. We have 80 workers living on-site. Take as much time as you need, and ask any worker directly if you've questions.
